violation_type.title: Diapering Procedures - Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §747.3307(e))
violation_type.short_title: Diapering Procedures - Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner
violation_type.typical_finding: Soiled diapers are disposed off in trash bag hanging from changing table which is accessible to children.     Note: Thia was corrected at inspection when provider removed the trash bag.

finding_variants.text: Soiled diapers are disposed off in trash bag hanging from changing table which is accessible to children.     Note: Thia was corrected at inspection when provider removed the trash bag.
Soiled diapers are not being kept in a sanitary manner.
Dirty diapers were observed in the restroom trashcan in a unsanitary manner.     NOTE: This was corrected when the trash was taken out.
A small trashcan with no lid was observed to have solid diapers in it. This was corrected at inspection when the Primary caregiver took the trash out.
